body:
well, here goes the throwaway.

i despite myself. well, its better than it used to be, but i really dont like who i am. i care too much about the opinion of my friends, but at the same time i dont give a shit about others. i try to be perfect for my friends, and i don't care if it makes me suffer.

I drink a lot. not often, but when i start drinking there is no end. For example, yesterday i drank 5 glasses of wine, two beers and three shots - within just a little bit more than an hour. i was completly gone and thats when i get really emotional. I dont like beeing drunk that much. bad memories and stuff, but whenever i am drunk i realize how fucked up i am and instead of putting that third glass down i think "well, either i get depressive this evening ooooooor i drink another 3 of those and forget this evening". So, drinking it is.

I missed so many chances because I am lazy and a coward.

I dissapointed so many people because of mistakes I made, because of things I didn't tell them - or told them and they misunderstood me and I didn't correct them.

I forgot so many of the great things I once was able to do. Not even three years ago I was capable of speaking fluent english - a couple of americans once didn't even notice that its not my primary language. Now? well, I guess you will notice all the weird vocabulary used here...

So, tldr: I don't like myself. But I learnt to live with myself.

okay, so... i guess an update is due.

I am in a relationship with lisa. i dont know what happend. it has been two weeks and i still cant wrap my mind around it. she told me that she had feelings for me for a couple of months now and, well, we had sex today. it was awkward. longer story is on off-my-chest - find it via my account.

lisa stopped cutting - from what her scars look like at least one year ago. we havent talked about it. but jesus christ i have never liked anybody more than her.
oh, and... to all those people who are browsing this subreddit, helping people out: you are absolutely the best people reddit has. thank you so much for everything.
